attributes.statement: The light shall be set to the commanded intensity (0-100%) and color for the commanded zone; an intensity of 0% shall switch the light off.
Commands shall be inhibited if vehicle power is OFF, an OTA update is in progress, or supply voltage is below 11.0 V.
An intensity outside 0-100% or a color that is not "#RRGGBB" shall be refused without commanding the actuator.
The capability shall publish its state in VSS terms, quantized to the datatypes the pinned standard declares.
The window shall move to the commanded target position (0-100%) within 4 seconds.
The window shall reverse direction if pinch resistance exceeds 100 N.
Commands shall be inhibited if vehicle power is OFF or supply voltage is below 12.0 V.
The capability shall publish its state in VSS terms, quantized to the datatypes the pinned standard declares.
